title: Human Papillomavirus in Menstrual Blood
brief_summary: The investigators tried to know whether a virus causing cervical cancer could be detected in menstrual blood and to set up a experimental setting to detect the virus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Premenopausal women with HSIL at Pap test or high-risk HPV

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suspicious cancer
study_population: Premenopausal women with HSIL at Pap test or high-risk HPV
